✨ claude-bridge | Java
🎯 Primary Use Case: Remote control and monitoring of Claude Code sessions from a mobile device without relying on cloud infrastructure.
✨ Key Features: • Full terminal mirroring on phone (xterm.js) • Support for multiple sessions and paired PCs • Push notifications for Claude Code hooks • Remote access via p2p tunnel (iroh) • Voice input for messages
📖 Summary: Claude Bridge allows users to mirror and control their Claude Code terminal sessions directly from an Android phone. It establishes a direct connection between the phone and the PC, either over a local network or via a p2p tunnel, eliminating the need for servers.
